findings.finding: The copy-drift test pins containment of bundled rules but doesn't guarantee the behavioral equivalence of the rest. If upstream `claude-plugin` later changes or removes an existing rule, containment passes only on rule identity as written today; the test will force additions but a modified rule (same key, changed content) needs an equality check on the rule objects, not just "contained."
findings.suggestion: Make the containment check deep-equality per rule key (rule object identical), not just presence — cheap and closes the modify-silently drift path.

findings.finding: The conftest.py guard's caveat "only when repo root is rootdir" means running pytest from a subdirectory (or with a nested tox/pytest config) silently drops the guard. The plan records the caveat in the rule text but the test doesn't pin the condition.
findings.suggestion: Either add a test invocation from a subdirectory showing the guard is skipped (documenting the boundary), or make the rule's note explicit that the test only asserts mechanism paths exist, not rootdir behavior.

findings.suggestion: Add a comment or doc line enumerating the defaults the project profile doesn't carry, so the acceptance is auditable rather than implicit.

  File: shared/tests/test_shipwright_monorepo_profile.py:18-21 — `sys.path.append(... shared/scripts)` then `import profile_resolver` / `import profile_architecture_rules` mutates the process-wide module search path for the whole pytest session.
